author: reek
body: The __narrow is load-bearing and this test did not have it until 2026-07-27, which is why it stopped compiling. Its prose used to say that 300 arriving through a plain-Integer parameter "is not a literal the static check could reject", and that was true when it was written. It is not now: CDX2051 refuses a bounded parameter whose argument has an unproven range, and refusing is the whole point -- the compiler will not silently insert a check you did not ask for. __narrow is how you ask, and its diagnostic says so.
